sections.markdown:
## E2 — Competitive teardown: emergency situations: collision avoidance, ABS, skids, drop-offs, vehicle malfunctions and breakdowns
No competitor was reviewed in this pass; names, prices, structure, pedagogy, practice style, praise, complaints and coverage are open (SC-EMG-TEARDOWN).
Adopt and beat lists stay empty until at least two named, priced competitors are examined from their own store or review pages.
Angle to test later: a step-ordering drill for blowouts, brake failure, engine failure and a stuck accelerator, taken from the South Carolina manual, could be a beat point once competitors are examined and verified.

corpus_stability.reason: The South Carolina Driver's Manual prints a single edition line (Revised 06/2024) on its front cover; its disclaimer says legislative and SCDMV policy changes may make some content out of date until the agency incorporates them, and a possibly newer unlinked upload exists on the issuer site (freshness debt in the run jams), so the corpus is treated as revised at most about once a year, bound to the registered snapshot.

verification_debt.claim_text: Competitive teardown of South Carolina permit-test prep products for the emergency situations: collision avoidance, ABS, skids, drop-offs, vehicle malfunctions and breakdowns topic is unresearched.
